discriminator.means: Both metastores are Free Edition in us-east-2. The primary is INTERNAL_AND_EXTERNAL and glovashu is INTERNAL. The capability is therefore available at this tier and probe 15's 403 is an unset switch. This is the one-variable control for B-18.

corroboration.means: The side that has external sharing enabled also carries a recipient token lifetime; the side that does not carries none. That is independent corroboration that glovashu has never had the feature switched on, rather than having it switched on and then restricted.
corroboration.decision_exposed: Recipient tokens are the credential that external recipients authenticate with. Their lifetime is therefore a security default the CONOPS must set explicitly, not inherit. Enabling the scope without choosing it is how a non-expiring external credential gets created by omission.

verified.means: A 200 on the PATCH is not the finding; the re-read is. An update that returns 200 and leaves the setting unchanged is the 12.9 shape with a success code on it.

second_field_required.means: The platform REFUSES to enable external Delta Sharing unless a recipient token lifetime is supplied in the same call. Enabling it is a two-field change and the second field is an external credential expiry.

prior_attempts_note: Earlier runs of this script, newest last. Kept because the refusals are evidence (B-19); a file showing only the successful call would misrepresent what enabling this took.

platform_enforced_control.means: Databricks rejected the one-field enable with 400 INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE naming the token lifetime. The risk flagged before the attempt -- external sharing switched on with a non-expiring recipient credential, created by omission -- is therefore not reachable through this API. The platform forces the expiry to be chosen.
platform_enforced_control.consequence_for_this_script: The NO_EXPIRY_SET warning branch in verified.credential_expiry cannot fire via the API route. It is retained for the account-console route and for API versions that may relax the requirement, but it must not be read as a passed check -- an unreachable guard that prints nothing forever is itself a silent negative (12.9).
platform_enforced_control.chosen_how: Matched to the primary metastore's existing lifetime rather than picked, so the two sides stay comparable; recorded as a decision the CONOPS owner should ratify, not as a default.
